# Project Plan

**Status**: Scaffolded
**Created**: 2026-05-06
**Mode**: NEW
**Working name**: `duo-scrapbook`

## 1. Project Overview

**Goal**: Two paired users (a "couple") sign in, upload photos to a shared collection, and view them in a scrapbook-style UI. Each photo gets an AI-generated caption from Azure OpenAI (GPT-4o vision) on upload. Every module is independently testable; full unit + integration test coverage required.

**App Type**: SPA + API
**Mode**: NEW
**Deployment Plan**: None (`.azure/deployment-plan.md` to be generated by `azure-prepare`)

### Core User Stories

1. As a new user, I can register and sign in with email + password (mock auth — swappable for Entra ID later).
2. As a signed-in user, I can create a couple and invite my partner via a one-time invite code.
3. As an invited user, I can join an existing couple by entering the invite code.
4. As a member of a couple, I can upload one or more photos to our shared scrapbook.
5. The system generates an AI caption per photo automatically.
6. As a member of a couple, I can browse photos in a scrapbook layout, see captions, and remove photos I uploaded.
7. As a member of a couple, I can regenerate a caption if I dislike the AI's first attempt.

| Backend | Azure Functions v4 (Node.js v4 programming model) |
| Frontend | React + Vite |
| Package Manager | npm (workspaces) |

## 3. Test Runner

| Component | Tech |
|-----------|------|
| Test Runner | Vitest (backend, frontend, shared) |
| Mocks | `vi.mock` + in-memory fakes per service interface |
| Test Command | `npm test` (root, runs all workspaces) |
| Coverage | `@vitest/coverage-v8` — gate at 80% lines / 80% branches |

> Each service has an in-memory fake (`MemoryDatabaseService`, `MemoryBlobStorageService`, `MemoryCaptionService`) registered via `registry.ts` to enable handler-level tests without emulators.

## 4. Services Required

| Service | Role | Env Var | Local Default | Classification |
|---------|------|---------|---------------|----------------|
| Blob Storage | Photo binary storage (`photos` container) | `STORAGE_CONNECTION_STRING` | `UseDevelopmentStorage=true` | Essential |
| PostgreSQL | Users, couples, invitations, photo metadata | `DATABASE_URL` | `postgresql://localdev:localdevpassword@localhost:5432/scrapbook` | Essential |
| Azure OpenAI | AI caption generation (GPT-4o vision) | `AZURE_OPENAI_ENDPOINT`, `AZURE_OPENAI_API_KEY`, `AZURE_OPENAI_DEPLOYMENT` | _(no emulator — fall back to placeholder caption locally)_ | Enhancement |

## 6. Route Definitions

| # | Method | Path | Description | Request | Response | Auth | Status |
|---|--------|------|-------------|---------|----------|------|--------|
| 1 | GET | `/api/health` | Health check | — | `{ status, services }` | None | 200, 503 |
| 2 | POST | `/api/auth/register` | Register new user | `{ email, password, displayName }` | `{ user, sessionToken }` | None | 201, 409, 422 |
| 3 | POST | `/api/auth/login` | Sign in | `{ email, password }` | `{ user, sessionToken }` | None | 200, 401, 422 |
| 4 | POST | `/api/auth/logout` | Sign out | — | `{ ok: true }` | Required | 204, 401 |
| 5 | GET | `/api/auth/me` | Current user | — | `{ user, couple }` | Required | 200, 401 |
| 6 | PATCH | `/api/users/me` | Update profile | `{ displayName?, avatarUrl? }` | `{ user }` | Required | 200, 401, 422 |
| 7 | POST | `/api/couples` | Create couple + invite code | `{ name }` | `{ couple, invite }` | Required | 201, 409, 422 |
| 8 | POST | `/api/couples/join` | Join couple by code | `{ code }` | `{ couple }` | Required | 200, 404, 409, 422 |
| 9 | GET | `/api/couples/me` | Get current couple + members | — | `{ couple, members }` | Required | 200, 401, 404 |
| 10 | DELETE | `/api/couples/me/leave` | Leave couple | — | `{ ok: true }` | Required | 204, 401, 404 |
| 11 | POST | `/api/photos` | Upload photo (multipart) → blob + caption | multipart `file`, `takenAt?` | `{ photo }` | Required + couple | 201, 401, 403, 422 |
| 12 | GET | `/api/photos` | List couple's photos (paginated) | query `?cursor&limit` | `{ photos, nextCursor }` | Required + couple | 200, 401, 403 |
| 13 | GET | `/api/photos/:id` | Get single photo | path UUID | `{ photo }` | Required + couple | 200, 401, 403, 404 |
| 14 | DELETE | `/api/photos/:id` | Delete photo (uploader or partner) | path UUID | — | Required + couple | 204, 401, 403, 404 |
| 15 | POST | `/api/photos/:id/regenerate-caption` | Regenerate AI caption | path UUID | `{ photo }` | Required + couple | 200, 401, 403, 404 |
| 16 | GET | `/api/openapi.json` | OpenAPI 3.1 spec | — | OpenAPI doc | None | 200 |

> All authenticated routes read `x-session-token` header (mock auth). `requireCouple` middleware ensures the user belongs to a couple before couple-scoped routes execute.

## 7. Database Constraints

| Table | Type | Column(s) | Detail |
|-------|------|-----------|--------|
| `users` | UNIQUE | `email` | Prevent duplicate registration (case-insensitive: stored lowercased) |
| `users` | FK | `couple_id → couples.id` | ON DELETE SET NULL |
| `users` | CHECK | `length(display_name) BETWEEN 1 AND 80` | Reasonable bounds |
| `couples` | CHECK | `length(name) BETWEEN 1 AND 80` | |
| `couples` | INDEX | `(created_at DESC)` | Listing |
| `invitations` | UNIQUE | `code` | Codes globally unique |
| `invitations` | FK | `couple_id → couples.id` | ON DELETE CASCADE |
| `invitations` | FK | `created_by_user_id → users.id` | ON DELETE CASCADE |
| `invitations` | CHECK | `status IN ('pending','accepted','revoked','expired')` | |
| `invitations` | INDEX | `(code) WHERE status = 'pending'` | Fast lookup at join time |
| `photos` | FK | `couple_id → couples.id` | ON DELETE CASCADE |
| `photos` | FK | `uploaded_by_user_id → users.id` | ON DELETE SET NULL |
| `photos` | UNIQUE | `(couple_id, blob_name)` | One row per blob |
| `photos` | CHECK | `size_bytes > 0 AND size_bytes <= 10485760` | 10 MB cap |
| `photos` | CHECK | `caption_status IN ('pending','ready','failed')` | |
| `photos` | INDEX | `(couple_id, created_at DESC)` | Scrapbook listing |
| `sessions` | FK | `user_id → users.id` | ON DELETE CASCADE |
| `sessions` | UNIQUE | `token_hash` | Token lookup |
| `sessions` | INDEX | `(expires_at)` | Cleanup |

### Multi-table writes wrapped in transactions

- `couples-create`: insert `couples` + update `users.couple_id` + insert `invitations`.
- `couples-join`: update `invitations.status` + update `users.couple_id`.
- `couples-leave`: update `users.couple_id = NULL` (and CASCADE clean-up on last member).
- `auth-register`: insert `users` + insert `sessions`.

### 7a. Collection → Table Mapping

| Collection (handler) | Table (migration) | Rule |
|----------------------|-------------------|------|
| `'user'` | `users` | camelToSnake + pluralize |
| `'couple'` | `couples` | camelToSnake + pluralize |
| `'invitation'` | `invitations` | camelToSnake + pluralize |
| `'photo'` | `photos` | camelToSnake + pluralize |
| `'session'` | `sessions` | camelToSnake + pluralize |

### Auto-managed columns (stripped on create/update)

`id`, `created_at`, `updated_at` — generated by DB defaults / triggers. The repo's `create()` and `update()` methods strip these before INSERT/UPDATE.

## 8. Service Dependency Classification

| Service | Type | Failure |
|---------|------|---------|
| PostgreSQL | Essential | 503 (health) / propagate 5xx (handlers) |
| Blob Storage | Essential | 503 (health) / propagate 5xx (handlers) |
| Azure OpenAI (caption) | Enhancement | Catch in handler; persist photo with `caption_status = 'failed'` and a placeholder caption ("A new memory."). Health reports `degraded`. |

> Enhancement service constructor (`OpenAICaptionService`) MUST NOT throw — it lazily validates config on first call.

## 11. Test Coverage Plan

| Layer | What's tested | Mechanism |
|-------|---------------|-----------|
| Shared schemas | Each Zod schema accepts valid + rejects invalid input | Vitest unit |
| Service interfaces (memory impls) | CRUD, transaction semantics, listing, blob put/get/delete, caption fallback | Vitest unit |
| Service interfaces (Postgres impl) | Smoke tests gated behind `INTEGRATION=1` env var (run against local Postgres) | Vitest integration (skipped when env unset) |
| Auth utils | Password hash/verify, session token issue/validate/expire, invite code generate/validate | Vitest unit |
| Handlers | Each route — success, validation failure, auth failure, not-found, conflict, enhancement degraded path | Vitest with `MemoryDatabaseService` + `MemoryBlobStorageService` + `MemoryCaptionService` |
| Error middleware | Maps each custom error class → correct status + code | Vitest unit |
| OpenAPI | Spec is valid JSON; every route in Section 6 is present | Vitest unit |
| Frontend hooks | `usePhotos`, `useUploadPhoto`, `useCouple` — loading/data/error/empty states | Vitest + @testing-library/react |
| Frontend components | `ScrapbookGrid`, `PhotoUploader`, `InviteCodeCard` — render + key interactions | Vitest + @testing-library/react |
| Coverage gate | Lines ≥ 80%, Branches ≥ 80%, Functions ≥ 80% per workspace | `@vitest/coverage-v8` thresholds enforced in `vitest.config.ts` |
